# United States West Coast Aquaculture Analysis

## Introduction

This assignment investigates which Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZ) on the West Coast of the United States have suitable sea surface temperature (SST) and depth values for developing marine aquaculture for multiple species of oysters and Yesso Scallop (_Mizuhopecten yessoensis_).

## Load Packages

```{r}
library(sf)          # vector handling
library(terra)       # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)        # map making
```

## Prepare Data

### Load Data

```{r}
# Load sea surface temperature data for 2008 to 2012
sst_2008 <- terra::rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
sst_2009 <- terra::rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
sst_2010 <- terra::rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
sst_2011 <- terra::rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
sst_2012 <- terra::rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')

# Stack sea surface temperature rasters
sst_2008_to_2012 <- c(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012)

```

```{r}
# Load ocean depth data
ocean_depth <- terra::rast('data/depth.tif')
```

```{r}
# Load Exclusive Economic Zones data
eez <- sf::st_read('data/wc_regions_clean.shp')
```

### Check Coordinate Reference Systems

```{r}
# Check if sea surface temperature and ocean depth raster CRS's match

if(st_crs(sst_2008_to_2012) == st_crs(ocean_depth)) {
  print('CRS match')
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('sst_2008_to_2012 CRS is', st_crs(sst_2008_to_2012)))
  print(paste('ocean_depth CRS is', st_crs(ocean_depth)))
}
```

```{r}
# Check if Exclusive Economic Zone data and sea surface temperature data CRS's match
if(st_crs(eez) == st_crs(sst_2008_to_2012)) {
  print('CRS match')
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('eez CRS is', st_crs(eez)))
  print(paste('sst_2008_to_2012 CRS is', st_crs(sst_2008_to_2012)))
}
```

## Process Data

Create raster of average sea surface temperature
```{r}
# Create single raster of average sea surface temperature
sst_mean <- terra::app(sst_2008_to_2012, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Convert mean sea surface temperature to degrees C
sst_mean_celcius <- sst_mean - 273.15
```

Crop ocean depth raster to match extent of sea surface temperature raster
```{r}
ocean_depth <- crop(ocean_depth, sst_mean_celcius)
```

Match ocean depth raster resolution to match resolution of sea surface temperature raster
```{r}
# Use bilinear method to resample ocean_depth and match sst_mean_celcius resolution
ocean_depth_resampled <- resample(ocean_depth, sst_mean_celcius, method = 'bilinear')
```

Check that ocean depth and sea surface surface temperature rasters match in resolution, extent, and coordinate reference system
```{r}
cat("After cropping and resampling ocean_depth_resampled:\n")
cat("Resolutions match:", all(res(ocean_depth_resampled) == res(sst_mean_celcius)), "\n")
cat("Extents match: ", ext(ocean_depth_resampled) == ext(sst_mean_celcius), "\n")
cat("Coordinate reference systems match: ", crs(ocean_depth_resampled) == crs(sst_mean_celcius))
```

Stack ocean depth and sea surface temperature rasters
```{r}
sst_and_depth <- c(sst_mean_celcius, ocean_depth_resampled)
```

## Find suitable locations for marine aquaculture

Oysters require the following conditions for optimal growth:

- Sea surface temperature in the range of 11 to 30 degrees celsius

- Depth of 0 to 70 meters below sea level

Yesso scallops (_Mizuhopecten yessoensis_) require the following conditions for optimal growth:

- (Sea surface temperature of 7 to 17 degrees celsius)[https://www.fao.org/fishery/culturedspecies/patinopecten_yessoensis/en/en] 

- (Depth of 0 to 100 meters below sea level)[https://www.sealifebase.ca/summary/Mizuhopecten-yessoensis.html]

```{r}
# Define function for determining and mapping areas suitable for marine aquaculture
map_suitable_areas <- function(temp_min, temp_max, depth_min, depth_max, species){

  # Define reclassification matrix for sea surface temperature
  sst_rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, temp_min, 0,
                temp_min, temp_max, 1,
                temp_max, Inf, 0),
                ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  # Define reclassification matrix for ocean depth
  depth_rcl <- matrix(c(-Inf, depth_min, 0,
                depth_min, depth_max, 1,
                depth_max, Inf, 0),
                ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  # Classify areas where sea surface temperature is suitable for species
  sst_suitable <- classify(sst_mean_celcius, rcl = sst_rcl)

  # Classify areas where depth is suitable for species
  depth_suitable <- classify(ocean_depth_resampled, rcl = depth_rcl)

  # Define areas where sea surface temperature and depth are suitable for species
  suitable_sites <- c(sst_suitable, depth_suitable) # Stack rasters
  suitable_sites <- lapp(stacked_sites, fun = function(s, d) (s*d)) # Create new raster where cells of suitable areas equal 1

  # Rasterize Exclusive Economic Zone data and set region ID as cell values
  eez_raster <- rasterize(eez, suitable_sites, field = "rgn_id")

  # Calculate area of suitable sites for aquaculture in square kilometers
  suitable_sites_area <- cellSize(suitable_sites, unit = 'km', mask = TRUE)

  # Mask cells in suitable_sites_area based on suitable_sites, change value of masked cells to 0
  suitable_sites_area <- mask(suitable_sites_area, suitable_sites, maskvalues = 0)

  # Sum area of suitable sites by eez region 
  suitable_area_by_eez <- zonal(suitable_sites_area, eez_raster, fun = 'sum', na.rm = TRUE)

  # Join suitable_area_by_ez with original eez data
  suitable_area_by_eez <- tibble(suitable_area_by_eez)

  suitable_area_by_eez <- inner_join(suitable_area_by_eez, eez, by = 'rgn_id') |> 
  mutate(suitable_area_km = area) |> # Rename area to suitable_area_km column
  select(-c(area, rgn_key, area_m2, area_km2)) |> # Remove unwanted columns
  st_as_sf() # Convert to simple feature to recognize geometries

  # Convert to simple feature to recognize geometries
  #suitable_area_by_eez <- st_as_sf(suitable_area_by_eez)

  suitable_area_map <- tm_basemap("OpenTopoMap") +
    tm_shape(suitable_area_by_eez) +
    tm_options(component.autoscale = FALSE) +
    tm_polygons(fill = 'suitable_area_km', lwd = 0.5, fill_alpha = 0.8,
              fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(
                  values = c('#edf8fb', '#b2e2e2', '#66c2a4', '#2ca25f', '#006d2c')),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Suitable Area,\nSquare km",
                                      title.size = 0.7,
                                      position = c('right', 'top'))) +
    tm_compass(position = c('left', 'bottom'), # Add compass
                size = 2) +
    tm_scalebar(position = c('left', 'bottom')) + # Add scalebar
    tm_title(text = paste('Area of West Coast Exclusive Economic Zones\nSuitable for', species, 'Aquaculture'),
              fontface = 'bold',
              position = tm_pos_out('center', 'top'))


  suitable_area_map
}
```

```{r}
map_suitable_areas(11,30,-70,0, species = 'Oyster')
```
